title: Enhance Solid Graph Topology System
description:
## Overview
Complete the Solid Graph topology implementation to make it production-ready for AI agents.

## Acceptance Criteria
All short-term and medium-term items must be completed. Documentation (AGENTS.md, README.md) must be updated for each new feature.

## Short-term (Required)
- [ ] \gr analysis scan <DIR>\ - Parse entire directory into unified graph
- [ ] Edge weights based on call frequency
- [ ] Populate issue \solid_volume\ from \ffected_symbols\

## Medium-term (Required)
- [ ] Persistent graph in \.grits/topology.json\
- [ ] \gr analysis diff\ - Compare topology before/after
- [ ] Integration with \gr context diff\
- [ ] Graph export (DOT/JSON)

## Long-term (Future)
- [ ] MCP auto-validation on edits
- [ ] VS Code real-time topology warnings
- [ ] \gr sync --validate-topology\
- [ ] Betti_2 (4-cliques)

See: .agent/workflows/topology-enhancements.md
